cards.heading: The heartbeat of the Great Commission

blocks.text: Evangelism is often called the heartbeat of God, and it is the Great Commission itself - the church's obligation to carry it out demands realistic strategy and good organisation. The Evangelism Department helps organise and manage the church's resources toward that end. It comprises sub-units such as the Drama group and the Follow-Up group, and is headed by a Head of Evangelism.

items: Assisting the Pastorate in planning, organising, and managing evangelistic efforts at church events.
Developing a framework for sustaining evangelistic efforts over time.
Collating the names of new converts and visitors at church events for follow-up.
Keeping statistical records of new, current, and returning church members, to help the Pastorate act where needed.
Setting evangelistic goals for specific periods, and meeting regularly to plan and pursue them.
Managing available resources to achieve church or group-defined evangelistic goals.
Organising and staging drama presentations at church events.
Providing regular reports of the department's activities to the Pastorate.

cards.heading: Qualities needed in Evangelism, Drama, and Follow-Up

items: Enthusiasm - a lively, energetic spirit is essential to be effective here.
A genuine passion for souls - the actual goal of all evangelism; without real love for people, the work becomes frustrating.
The ability to meet and talk with people politely and boldly, wherever led.
The ability to act on stage, for those in the Drama unit specifically.
Time and availability - this unit demands as much of both as any other.
Commitment and dedication - consistency matters greatly here.
Resilience - following up takes persistence; giving up too soon rarely produces results.
A personal testimony of salvation, and a readiness to share it - no one can give what they don't have.
A good knowledge of the Bible - it's dangerous to go out representing the word of God in ignorance of it.
